(4 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) Dealing damage with a Storm Calling ability's initial hit or every 5th tick creates a Monolith near the enemy for |cffffff10|r seconds, up to one every |cffffff1|r second, up to 3 total. Your Monoliths within 28 meters of one another link together, dealing |cffffff742|r Shock Damage, scaling off of the higher of your Weapon or Spell Damage, every |cffffff2|r seconds to enemies near the links, up to once every |cffffff2|r seconds per enemy.

Each Monolith active grants you |cffffff100|r Weapon and Spell Damage.
